output.question: What is CleanSpark's short interest?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, CleanSpark (NASDAQ: CLSK) had 78.75 million shares sold short. That equals 31.94% of the reported float and 30.66% of shares outstanding; the short ratio was 4.54 days. These figures come from StockAnalysis.com's stock-statistics data, observed on November 11, 2026 [1](#cite-1).
